name: China — 1 December 2025

entries.instructions: 中国人大网 (NPC). Authority for the national statutes and NPC Standing Committee decisions: 劳动法 (hours, overtime caps and premiums, rest), 劳动合同法 (contracts, probation, termination grounds, notice, economic compensation N/2N, final settlement), 社会保险法 (the five insurances, contribution duties, withholding), 个人所得税法, 工会法 (2% union fund), 个人信息保护法 (statute text), 就业促进法, and the 2024 decision on the gradual raising of the statutory retirement age. Use 法律法规 / 法律文本 and the 全国人大常委会公报; check the promulgation and commencement dates and every later amendment decision.

中国政府网 (State Council). Authority for: the annual 国务院办公厅关于部分节假日安排的通知 (调休, makeup workdays; usually published in November for the next year) and 全国年节及纪念日放假办法; State Council administrative regulations and ministry rules in 国务院政策文件库 (zhengceku): 职工带薪年休假条例 and 企业职工带薪年休假实施办法, 劳动合同法实施条例, 女职工劳动保护特别规定 (maternity leave), 工伤保险条例, 失业保险条例, 最低工资规定, 工资支付暂行规定, 保障农民工工资支付条例, 住房公积金管理条例, the 21.75-day monthly pay-day notice, national MOHRSS/MOF notices on the phased unemployment-insurance rate, and the foreign-worker rules (外国人在中国就业管理规定, 在中国境内就业的外国人参加社会保险暂行办法, 外国人入境出境管理条例). Search 政策 > 国务院政策文件库 by title or 文号.

国家互联网信息办公室. Authority for the implementing rules of employee personal-data protection: personal information protection compliance audits, sensitive personal information handling, the cross-border transfer rules (标准合同办法, 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 and its HR-management exemption) and security assessments. Use 政务 > 政策法规 and 通知公告; the PIPL statute text itself is under npc.gov.cn.

上海市人力资源和社会保障局. Authority for Shanghai: the monthly and hourly minimum wage and its exclusions, the social-insurance contribution base floor and ceiling (contribution year from 1 July), pension, unemployment and work-injury rates and industry classes, 上海市企业工资支付办法 (overtime base, final pay, stoppage pay, deductions), sick-pay scale and medical period, the high-temperature allowance and the one-off work-injury subsidies. Use 政务公开 > 政策文件 (沪人社规) and 通知公告; read the PDF of each 沪人社规.

上海市医疗保障局. Authority for Shanghai employee basic medical insurance (including maternity) rates and base, maternity benefits and long-term-care insurance. Use 政务公开 > 规范性文件 (沪医保规) and check each notice's 有效期 (the medical rate notice is time-limited).

国家税务总局上海市税务局. Authority for all tax and tax-collected levies (the national 国家税务总局 portals fgk.chinatax.gov.cn and www.chinatax.gov.cn answer automated readers with a script challenge): in 政策文件 > 政策法规库 (个人所得税 and 社会保险费 categories) the national IIT instruments it republishes — the cumulative withholding method (公告2018年第61号) and rate table, the 5,000 basic deduction and special additional deductions (国发〔2023〕13号 and later amounts), preferential treatments (annual bonus, separation pay, equity incentives, expatriate allowances and their expiry dates) and the monthly declaration calendar; and Shanghai collection — social-insurance and union-fund payment and declaration due days, the annual contribution-base declaration window, the disabled-employment security fund rate and calculation, and local IIT withholding guidance (纳税服务 > 办税指南, 通知公告).

上海市人民政府. Authority for Shanghai local regulations and government rules not issued by the bureaus above: 上海市人口与计划生育条例 (extended maternity, paternity, marriage and childcare leave), 上海市女职工劳动保护办法 (prenatal and nursing leave), 上海市老年人权益保障条例 (elder-care leave), 上海市工会条例, and the 上海市住房公积金管理委员会 notices on housing-fund rates and base limits (the fund centre's own site is unreachable). Use 政策发布 / 信息公开 > 规章 and the site search.

云南人大网 (Yunnan Provincial People's Congress). Authority for Yunnan and Kunming local regulations: 云南省人口与计划生育条例 (extended maternity, paternity, marriage and childcare leave), 云南省老年人权益保障条例 (elder-care leave), 云南省失业保险条例, and Kunming regulations it approves such as 昆明市工资支付条例 (final pay within 5 working days, sick and stoppage pay). Use 权威发布 > 常委会公告 / 决议决定 and the site search; check amendment decisions. The site is intermittently slow: retry once before reporting it unreachable.

龙陵县人民政府 (a Yunnan county portal that republishes province-wide notices; the 云南省人社厅 and 云南省税务局 portals are unreachable from the research hosts). Use it only for Yunnan province-wide instruments: the minimum-wage classes (云人社发 最低工资标准) and the Kunming county classification, the pension, unemployment and work-injury contribution bases and rates (including the phased unemployment rate), Yunnan work-injury local measures and the Yunnan high-temperature allowance. Use 政务公开 search for 社会保险 / 最低工资 / 人社; quote the provincial 文号 and confirm the notice is province-wide.

sources.instructions: Compare the complete jurisdiction snapshot against operative, published official law. Specific document URLs are evidence citations, not source registry entries. Apply each entry's own extraction guidance; an area belongs to the one entry that names it. Open each portal directly and use its navigation or site search. Record the exact document URL, issuer, instrument number, publication and effective dates, the quoted clause or table and its scope for each proposed change. Read annexes and amendments; inspect scanned PDFs visually. A draft, 征求意见稿, budget speech or press summary is not operative law. Never sign in or upload customer records. Kunming municipal medical security (昆明市医疗保障局) and the Kunming housing provident fund centre have no portal the research tools can reach (km.gov.cn hosts return empty replies or time out): report those values as unverified rather than guessing.

change_summary: First CN version: law in force on 1 December 2025 — Shanghai (SH) and Kunming (KM) social insurance and housing provident fund for the 2025 contribution years, unemployment insurance at the phased 1% rate (to 31 December 2025), IIT cumulative withholding (Individual Income Tax Law 2018, 国发〔2023〕13号 special additional deductions, 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号 annual-bonus separate taxation to 31 December 2027).

employment_type.description: 劳动合同法 第十二条: PERMANENT 无固定期限, FIXED_TERM 固定期限, PROJECT 以完成一定工作任务为期限; PART_TIME 非全日制用工 (第六十八条, work-injury insurance only); INTERN a student intern and RETIREE_REHIRE a re-hired retiree are not in a labour relationship and outside social insurance and the housing provident fund.

work_classification.description: 劳动法 第三十六条、第三十九条; 劳动部《关于企业实行不定时工作制和综合计算工时工作制的审批办法》(劳部发〔1994〕503号): standard hours, approved comprehensive hours, or approved flexible hours.

residency_status.description: 个人所得税法 第一条: RESIDENT has a domicile in China or stays 183 days or more in the tax year; NON_RESIDENT otherwise. IIT refuses any other value.

si_contribution_base.title: Declared social insurance and HPF contribution base (月缴费基数)
si_contribution_base.description: 社会保险法 第十二条; 住房公积金管理条例 第十六条: the prior-year monthly average wage declared each contribution year (a new hire: the first month's wage). Stored on the contract terms (`terms.facts`). Unrecorded is the contract monthly wage. The city floor and ceiling apply.

written_contract_signed_on.title: Written labour contract signed on
written_contract_signed_on.description: 劳动合同法 第十条、第八十二条: the day the written contract was concluded; absent one month after hire raises WRITTEN_CONTRACT_OVERDUE (double wages), absent after a year DEEMED_OPEN_ENDED_CONTRACT.

hourly_rate.title: Hourly rate (part-time)
hourly_rate.description: 劳动合同法 第七十二条: checked against the local hourly minimum wage.

probation.title: Probation term (试用期)
probation.description: 劳动合同法 第十九条、第二十条.

contract_wage.title: Agreed post-probation wage
contract_wage.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条: probation pay at least 80% of it.

post_lowest_wage.title: Lowest wage of the same post
post_lowest_wage.description: 劳动合同法 第二十条.

comprehensive_cycle_months.title: Comprehensive-hours cycle (months)
comprehensive_cycle_months.description: 劳部发〔1994〕503号: the approved cycle (month, quarter, year).

high_temperature_exposed.title: Outdoor or uncooled work in summer (Shanghai)

social_insurance_waived.title: Social insurance waiver (void)
social_insurance_waived.description: 法释〔2025〕12号 第十九条: refused.

school_vacation_days.title: Statutory school vacation days a year (寒暑假)
school_vacation_days.description: 职工带薪年休假条例 第四条(一); 实施办法 第七条: annual leave is reduced by these days, none when they reach it.

employee_requested_fixed_term.title: Employee asked for a fixed term (劳动者提出订立固定期限劳动合同)
employee_requested_fixed_term.description: 劳动合同法 第十四条第二款: after 10 years or two consecutive fixed terms, a fixed-term renewal stands only at the employee's request.

fixed_term.description: A fixed-term contract: while true the employment is not permanent (`permanent_when`).

layoff_batch_size.title: People cut in the same layoff
layoff_batch_size.description: 劳动合同法 第四十一条: 20 or more, or 10% of the workforce, needs the 30-day explanation and report.

employee_refused_renewal_on_equal_terms.title: Employee refused renewal on equal or better terms
employee_refused_renewal_on_equal_terms.description: 劳动合同法 第四十六条第五项: no compensation on expiry.

occupational_disease_or_injury.title: Occupational disease, suspected, or work injury (protected)
occupational_disease_or_injury.description: 劳动合同法 第四十二条第一、二项.

reference_number.description: Social security number or tax identification number of the person for this scheme.

children_education_children.title: Children in education (子女教育)
children_education_children.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: 2000 a month for each child from age 3 to the end of full-time education.

children_education_split.title: Children education split 50/50 with the other parent
children_education_split.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第六条: one parent takes 100% or each takes 50%.

infant_care_children.title: Children under 3 (3岁以下婴幼儿照护)
infant_care_children.description: 国发〔2022〕8号 as raised by 国发〔2023〕13号: 2000 a month for each child under 3.

infant_care_split.title: Infant care split 50/50 with the other parent

continuing_education_degree.title: Degree continuing education (学历继续教育)
continuing_education_degree.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第八条: 400 a month during the degree education, at most 48 months.

housing_loan_interest.title: First-home loan interest (住房贷款利息)
housing_loan_interest.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第十四条: 1000 a month, at most 240 months; not with housing rent.

housing_rent.title: Housing rent (住房租金)
housing_rent.description: 国发〔2018〕41号 第十七条第一项: 1500 a month in a municipality or provincial capital (Shanghai, Kunming); not with loan interest.

elderly_support_only_child.title: Only child supporting a parent aged 60+ (赡养老人)
elderly_support_only_child.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: 3000 a month for an only child.

elderly_support_monthly.title: Agreed elderly-support share (not an only child)
elderly_support_monthly.description: 国发〔2023〕13号: siblings share 3000 a month, at most 1500 each.

annual_bonus_separate.title: Tax the annual one-time bonus separately
annual_bonus_separate.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第30号: to 31 December 2027 the annual bonus may be taxed apart from comprehensive income, once a year.

first_job_in_year.title: First wage income of the year (公告2020年第13号)
first_job_in_year.description: Cumulative deduction from January in the hire month.

personal_pension_monthly.title: Personal pension contribution a month
personal_pension_monthly.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2022年第34号: 12,000 a year.

annuity_employee_monthly.title: Enterprise annuity employee contribution a month
annuity_employee_monthly.description: 财税〔2013〕103号: up to 4% of the base.

foreign_allowance_exemption.title: Foreign allowance exemption instead of special deductions
foreign_allowance_exemption.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2023年第29号.

china_workday_share.title: Share of the month worked in China (non-resident)
china_workday_share.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2019年第35号 第二条: a non-resident's wage 收入额 is the China-workday share (境内工作天数 ÷ 当期公历天数). Customer input; default 1.

retirement_category.title: Original statutory retirement age (women)
retirement_category.description: 全国人民代表大会常务委员会《关于实施渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的决定》(2024年9月13日, 自2025年1月1日) 及《国务院关于渐进式延迟法定退休年龄的办法》第二条: 男职工和原法定退休年龄为五十五周岁的女职工每四个月延迟一个月, 分别逐步延迟至六十三周岁和五十八周岁; 原法定退休年龄为五十周岁的女职工每二个月延迟一个月, 逐步延迟至五十五周岁 https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202409/content_6974294.htm. Women record `retirement_category` FEMALE_55 (cadres) or FEMALE_50 (default, workers).

only_child.title: Only child (独生子女)
only_child.description: 上海市老年人权益保障条例 (陪护假 7 days); 云南省老年人权益保障条例 第二十四条 (护理假 20 days).

si_exempt_schemes.title: Schemes exempted by a social-security agreement
si_exempt_schemes.description: 人社部令第16号 and the bilateral agreement: the schemes the certificate of coverage exempts.

hpf_voluntary.title: Joins the housing provident fund voluntarily (foreign / HK / MO / TW)
hpf_voluntary.description: 上海市住房公积金缴存管理办法; 建金〔2017〕237号.

non_domiciled_resident.title: Resident without domicile in China
non_domiciled_resident.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2019年第35号 第二条: wages apportioned by the China-workday share.

minor_employment_approved.title: Approved employment under 16 (文艺、体育、特种工艺)
minor_employment_approved.description: 劳动法 第十五条: an arts, sports or special-crafts unit may employ a person under 16 with approval.

offshore_paid_share.title: Share of wages paid from abroad (境外支付工资 ÷ 境内外工资总额)
offshore_paid_share.description: 财政部 税务总局公告2019年第35号 二(二): only wages paid from abroad for work abroad are excluded. 0 when the PRC entity pays everything.

consecutive_resident_years.title: Completed consecutive 183-day years before this one
consecutive_resident_years.description: 公告2019年第35号 二(二)2: from the 7th consecutive year all wages are taxed.

facts.description: Person facts on employment_profile.facts; no CN rule reads one.

hpf_rate_percent.title: Housing provident fund rate (%)
hpf_rate_percent.description: 住房公积金管理条例 第十八条: employer and employee at the same rate; Shanghai 5–7%, Kunming 5–12%.

hpf_supplementary_rate_percent.title: Shanghai supplementary HPF rate (%)
hpf_supplementary_rate_percent.description: Shanghai 补充住房公积金 1–5%; unrecorded is none.

work_injury_rate_percent.title: Notified work-injury rate (%)
work_injury_rate_percent.description: 人社部发〔2015〕71号: the floated rate the social insurance agency notified; unrecorded is the industry-class base rate (risk_class 1–8).

union_established.title: Trade union established
union_established.description: 工会法 第四十三条: a unit with a union remits 2% of total wages.

state_owned.title: State-owned unit (全民所有制)
state_owned.description: 国务院关于职工探亲待遇的规定 第二条: home-visit leave and its fares bind 国家机关、人民团体和全民所有制企业、事业单位.

unified_social_credit_code.title: 统一社会信用代码
unified_social_credit_code.description: The employer registration number for tax (IIT withholding) and social insurance registration.

si_registration_number.title: Social insurance employer number (单位社保编号)

hpf_account_number.title: Housing provident fund employer account (单位公积金账号)

rest_day_work_compensated.title: Rest-day work compensated by time off (补休)
rest_day_work_compensated.description: 劳动法 第四十四条第二项: rest-day work is paid at 200% only when no compensatory rest is arranged; an entity that arranges it records true.

wi_voluntary_interns_and_retirees.title: Shanghai: interns and over-age workers in work-injury insurance
wi_voluntary_interns_and_retirees.description: 沪人社规〔2025〕22号 (from 2025-12-01): the employer may insure interns and workers past retirement age for work injury only.

established_on.title: Date of establishment (成立日期)
established_on.description: 社会保险法 第五十七条; 住房公积金管理条例 第十四条: the 30-day unit registrations run from it.

local_average_annual_wage.title: Local average annual wage (上年职工平均工资)
local_average_annual_wage.description: 财税〔2018〕164号 五(一): termination pay within 3 × this figure is exempt from IIT. The city's published figure.

employs_migrant_workers.title: Employs migrant workers (农民工)
employs_migrant_workers.description: 保障农民工工资支付条例 第十五条: wage ledger kept 3 years.

wage_payday.title: Agreed pay day (day of month)
wage_payday.description: 工资支付暂行规定 第七条.

wage_payday_month_offset.title: Pay day month (0 the same month, 1 the next)
wage_payday_month_offset.description: 工资支付暂行规定 第七条.

union_preparatory.title: Trade union preparatory organisation established (工会筹备组织)
union_preparatory.description: 上海市工会条例 第四十一条: a Shanghai unit with a union preparatory organisation remits 2% of total wages from its establishment.

transfers_hr_data_abroad.title: Sends employee data to an overseas group (跨境人力资源管理)
transfers_hr_data_abroad.description: 促进和规范数据跨境流动规定 第五条(二); 个人信息保护法 第三十九条.

prior_year_average_headcount.title: Prior-year average headcount (上年用人单位在职职工人数)

prior_year_disabled_employees.title: Prior-year disabled employees (上年实际安排残疾人就业人数)

prior_year_average_wage.title: Prior-year average annual wage of the entity (上年在职职工年平均工资)
prior_year_average_wage.description: 财税〔2015〕72号 第八条; capped at 2× the local average.

wage_zone.title: Minimum-wage zone of the region (最低工资档次)
wage_zone.description: The zone key of the region's minimum-wage table (`rules.regions`; Kunming classes 1–3); blank = the region's default zone. Also the Kunming housing-fund floor.

sick_pay_percent.title: Sick pay (% of wage, employer policy)
sick_pay_percent.description: Where the region sets only a floor (`rules.regions.*.sick_pay.scale` null): the share of the wage the employer pays on sick leave; unrecorded is the floor (80% of the minimum wage, 劳部发〔1995〕309号 第59条).

suspension_kinds.name: 停工停产 (stoppage for the employer's operational reasons)
suspension_kinds.authority: 工资支付暂行规定 第十二条: 非因劳动者原因造成单位停工、停产在一个工资支付周期内的, 应按劳动合同规定的标准支付工资; 超过一个工资支付周期的, 若劳动者提供了正常劳动, 支付的劳动报酬不得低于当地的最低工资标准; 若没有提供正常劳动, 应按国家有关规定办理. 人社厅明电〔2020〕5号 二 https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-01/27/content_5472508.htm: 职工没有提供正常劳动的, 企业应当发放生活费, 生活费标准按各省、自治区、直辖市规定的办法执行. SH: 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 十二 https://rsj.sh.gov.cn/cmsres/ee/ee4c819d093644fe9dbd470d2aa0d1dd/3bf28e8da2b7faa5c9fc6359be7780fc.pdf. The first cycle runs a month from the suspension's first day (`suspension.from`, across pay periods); after it the suspension fact `agreed_daily_pay` is the new agreement. A later day not worked pays the living allowance (生活费), the suspension fact `living_allowance_daily`, else nothing: neither city sets a statutory amount. KM: 云南省人力资源和社会保障厅《关于新型冠状病毒感染的肺炎疫情防控期间劳动关系的政策解答》 四 (on 云人社通〔2020〕12号, 2020-01-31): 超过一个工资支付周期的, 若职工提供了正常劳动, 企业支付给职工的工资按照双方新约定的标准支付, 但不得低于当地最低工资标准. 职工没有提供正常劳动的, 企业按照企业规章制度规定或者集体合同、劳动合同约定的标准发放生活费 (read 2026-10-08 as official reproductions on WeChat: 云南人才市场 2020-02-07 “来源于云南人力资源和社会保障网”, with the notice scan; 云视新闻七彩云 2020-02-05; 918云南交通台 2020-02-05 from 云南发布; all verbatim). The notice itself (三) stops at the minimum wage for days worked; 昆明市工资支付条例 第二十八条 sets no amount. SH: 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 十二 sets none either.

The notice itself (三) stops at the minimum wage for days worked; 昆明市工资支付条例 第二十八条 sets no amount. SH: 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 十二 sets none either. A disaster is a cause not the employee's: 第十二条 applies.

A government measure (e.g. the epidemic controls of 人社厅明电〔2020〕5号) is a cause not the employee's: 第十二条 applies.

suspension_kinds.name: 劳动者原因停工 (stoppage caused by the employees)
suspension_kinds.authority: 劳动法 第五十条 and 工资支付暂行规定 第十二条 a contrario: wages are paid for labour provided; a stoppage the employees cause is outside 第十二条, unpaid and not attended. PRC law has no statutory strike pay. https://yjglt.yn.gov.cn/html/2024/yunnanshengwenjian_0507/28616.html
